facts.statement: Messelirrisor is the only genus in the extinct family Messelirrisoridae within the order Bucerotiformes.
facts.quote: The extinct Messelirrisor is a genus of Bucerotiformes, the sole representative of the family Messelirrisoridae.

facts.statement: Messelirrisor were tiny birds that resembled modern hoopoes.
These birds were common small forest inhabitants of Central Europe during the Middle Eocene, approximately 49 to 37 million years ago.
facts.quote: they were among the predominant small forest birds of Central Europe during the Middle Eocene (some 49-37 mya)

facts.statement: Fossils of Messelirrisor have been discovered at the Messel Pit in Hesse, Germany.
facts.quote: Fossilized remains of Messelirrisor have been found in the Messel Pit of Hesse, Germany.

facts.statement: The family of Messelirrisor is classified as Messelirrisoridae.
Messelirrisor were small birds with an appearance similar to modern hoopoes but smaller in size.
facts.quote: Estas pequeñas aves, de aspecto similar a las actuales abubillas pero de menor tamaño

facts.statement: Messelirrisor lived in forests covering Central Europe during the Middle Eocene, between 53 and 49 million years ago.
facts.quote: vivieron en los bosques que cubrían Europa central en el Eoceno Medio (entre 53 y 49 maa)

facts.statement: Messelirrisor is considered to be an arboreal bird.
facts.quote: Messelirrisor es considerado como un ave arborícola

facts.statement: Messelirrisor occupied the ecological niche of certain passerine groups before those birds had arrived in Europe.
facts.quote: ocupaba el nicho de algunos grupos de Passeriformes cuando estos aún no habían llegado a Europa

facts.statement: Messelirrisor may have been insectivorous, as its beak shape is similar to that of other hoopoe and wood-hoopoe groups.
facts.quote: Al igual que estas aves, Messelirrisor pudo haber sido insectívoro, ya que la forma del pico es similar a los grupos antes mencionados

facts.statement: Found specimens include complete and articulated skeletons along with preserved feather remains.
facts.quote: Los especímenes encontrados incluyen esqueletos completos y articulados junto a restos del plumaje

facts.statement: The family Messelirrisoridae represents the oldest known group including modern hoopoes (Upupidae) and wood-hoopoes (Phoeniculidae).
facts.quote: La familia Messelirrisoridae constituye el representante más antiguo del grupo que incluye a las abubillas (familia Upupidae) y abubillas arbóreas (familia Phoeniculidae)

facts.statement: In the species M. parvus, beak length varies between individual specimens.
facts.quote: En la especie M. parvus la longitud del pico varía entre especímenes

facts.statement: The time range for Messelirrisor is the Lutetian stage, from 48.07 to 41.03 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Lutetian to Lutetian (48.07 to 41.03 million years ago)
